newsitem.title: FRANCE: Comptoirs shares up after block trades.
newsitem.headline: Comptoirs shares up after block trades.

text.p: Shares in Comptoirs Modernes rose on Tuesday in heavy volume after several block trades accounting for about 0.48 percent of the capital of the French distribution group.
The stock hit a year high of 2,474 francs and at 1447 GMT was trading at 2,444 francs, up 91 francs or 3.87 percent. The CAC 40 leading share index was up 0.72 percent at the same time.
Some traders were somewhat perplexed by the rise but others said a block trade of 20,000 earlier appeared to have triggered other purchases.
Some 25,000 shares changed hands at a price of 2,460 francs, while the block trade of 20,000 shares was done at 2,470 francs.
Traders also raised the possibility of Carrefour bolstering its 23 percent holding in Comptoirs. Carrefour denied the rumour.
